values.meaning: duration the Black Mist stays attached before spreading and rooting

mechanics.claim: The projectile deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and attaches to them for 1 second before the mist spreads out and roots them and surrounding enemies.
mechanics.quote: throws a globule of Black Mist in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and attaches to them for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: The primary target will not be rooted if they are untargetable when the mist spreads.
mechanics.quote: ''Last Embrace'' will not {{tip|root}} the primary target if they are {{tip|untargetable}}.

mechanics.claim: Damage is dealt only once, to the first enemy hit by the projectile; the later root pulse is not a second damage instance.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit
